description: Infrastructure: add httparse dep, change PooledConn to an enum with H2/H1 variants, and make new_connection() read ALPN to choose the right variant. This wires the dispatch without implementing H1 execution (FEAT-002 does that). After this FEAT the codebase compiles with the H1 arm calling a stub that returns unimplemented!().
steps: Add `httparse = "1"` to [dependencies] in crates/client/Cargo.toml. This is the only new dependency needed — we write the H1 send/recv manually using tokio::io, and use httparse only for parsing the status line and headers.
In crates/client/src/lib.rs, add `use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};` to the existing use block (already used implicitly, make explicit for H1).

Fix the two use sites of the old `PooledConn` struct fields in `execute_single_with_method()`:
  a) The stale connection fallback: `if let Some(mut entry) = pooled { match entry { PooledConn::H2 { ref mut conn, ref mut encoder, ref mut decoder } => { ... old H2 send_request ... } PooledConn::H1 { .. } => unimplemented!("H1 pool reuse") } }`
  b) The `self.client.pool.lock().await.insert(pool_key, entry)` — entry is now a `PooledConn` enum so no struct literal construction needed; just insert the value.
  For the H1 arm in the execute dispatch, call `unimplemented!("H1 execute — see FEAT-002")` as a temporary stub.

Add `H1` error variant to `ClientError` for use in H1 execution:
```rust
#[error("h1: {0}")]
H1(String),
```
This covers parse errors and protocol errors in the H1 path.
acceptance_criteria: cargo build -p rusthttp succeeds with 0 errors (the unimplemented!() stub is dead code until FEAT-002 completes but the code must compile)
cargo test -p rusthttp — all pre-existing tests pass (H2 path unchanged)
new_connection() dispatches to PooledConn::H1 when ALPN is http/1.1 or None, and to PooledConn::H2 when ALPN is h2
verification: cd C:\Users\Dan Li\.cargo\git\checkouts\rusthttp-c4c5c4911e7b70c8\d70a526 && cargo build -p rusthttp 2>&1 | Select-String 'error' -- must return 0 lines
cargo test -p rusthttp -- --test-output immediate 2>&1 | tail -10 -- must show 'test result: ok'
findings: Pre-existing test compilation errors fixed alongside FEAT-001: (1) integration.rs called .chrome() with 0 args but API requires version param — fixed to .chrome(None); (2) resp.text().expect() failed because text() returns String not Result — fixed to resp.text() + &body for serde_json::from_str. PooledConn enum dispatch uses move destructuring (not ref mut) to avoid borrow-checker issues when reconstructing the enum after send_request. ALPN check uses let is_h2: bool to avoid lifetime issue with Option<&[u8]> borrow of tls_stream.
